dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't do anything that impressive...

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: So modest, too! Miss Voyanisha mentioned that as well. You really are just like she said.

dialogues.speaker: Tolstaya
dialogues.text: Are you here to order something? In that case, please have a look at the menu. I promise I'll use only the finest ingredients!
